name: InMode Optimas

lead: Optimas (marketed as OptimasMAX) is a clinic platform from InMode that houses several treatment modules on one console. These include fractional radiofrequency for skin tightening, intense pulsed light for pigment and redness, laser hair removal and vascular treatment.
For appearance, a practice can use it to tighten skin, reduce sun spots and visible veins and remove hair. Which treatments are available depends on the modules and local approvals.

paras: It is operated by trained practitioners using interchangeable handpieces: Morpheus8 Burst for RF microneedling at several depths, Lumecca Peak IPL, Fusion hair removal, VasculazeMAX for veins and Forma for bipolar RF. Practices often combine treatments.
The manufacturer's page notes RF microneedling can cause burns, scarring, unanticipated fat loss and nerve damage, and that results vary. It states approved intended use varies by country.

lead: InMode Optimas, marketed as OptimasMAX, is a multi-functional aesthetic platform for fractional radiofrequency (FRF), intense pulsed light (IPL), hair removal and vascular treatments. The manufacturer describes it as offering more power, enhanced control and faster outcomes, with programmable software and a large LCD screen.

The platform hosts several modules: Morpheus8 Burst and Burst Deep (bipolar RF at multiple depths for skin contraction), Lumecca Peak (IPL with a xenon flash lamp for vascular and pigmented lesions and photodamage), Fusion Light and Fusion Dark (hair removal at 755, 810 and 1064 nm), VasculazeMAX (visible and spider veins, port-wine stains) and Forma and Forma Plus (bipolar RF for dermal and subdermal zones).

Aesthetic practices use it for skin tightening and texture, pigment and redness, vein treatment and hair removal. The manufacturer states that approved intended use varies by country and that RF microneedling has risks including burns, scarring, unanticipated fat loss and nerve damage.

Morpheus8 Burst, Lumecca Peak, Fusion, VasculazeMAX, Forma

paras: Optimas combines multiple modalities on one console with programmable software and ergonomic handpieces. Fractional RF modules include Morpheus8 Burst and the 40-pin Burst Deep tip; light-based modules include Lumecca Peak IPL and Fusion hair removal; VasculazeMAX targets veins and vascular lesions.
The manufacturer notes risks of RF microneedling including burns, scarring, unanticipated fat loss and nerve damage, and says results vary.
